execution_policy: real Linux/KVM selected; preemption primary, cooperation fallback; this fixture executes neither backend mode
caller_ownership: one caller OS thread for world, machines, devices and scenario actions
framing: little-endian u32 payload byte length followed by UTF-8 JSON; maximum payload 16777216 bytes
transport: reserved reliable control device, distinct from opaque Ethernet application frames; observations retained until ordered Ack; duplicate identical commands are idempotent
control_ownership: controller stable ID + controller incarnation + monotonically ordered command ID; workload ownership: machine stable ID + boot incarnation + request ID
state_coverage: World command ingress and complete payloads
reliable response/observation outbox and ack sequences
volatile/durable block state and pending physical effects
workload and immune scenario-VM stopped-guest counter declarations
native controller program, pc, locals and pending command
observer_history: World trace is excluded from state; restored future regenerates without a prior execution log
ordering: one registered event; finish backend I/O/actions; publish observations; resume controller before next event at same tick
clock: integer branch-count-domain Tick; executed guest delta imported once at a stopped semantic boundary; all-blocked idle event jump is explicit model policy; rational integer ClockPolicy converts ticks into Linux ns and is not measured physical time

stopped_guest_boundary.policy: debugger administration is outside semantic numbering; natural PIO/MMIO exits during correction are DeviceExit boundaries; completion-only delta is zero and imports change no canonical world state or numbering; scripted models cannot declare PrecisePreemption
